$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-e^{-x}\cos y，\quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=-e^{-x}\sin y，\quad \frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y^2}=-e^{-x}\cos y，$

则 $\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right)^2+\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y^2}=e^{-2x}\cos^2y-e^{-x}\cos y$
